mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals expanding economic activity, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in quarters with rising GDPC1 growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers monetary tightening, increasing risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in periods where FEDFUNDS >4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and monthly supply (INDPRO) creates a balanced economic environment that reduces uncertainty, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of GDPC1 and INDPRO does not significantly predict 20-day returns (p >0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL inflation index exceeds 215.5, signaling high inflation pressures, risk aversion rises, depressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in periods with CPIAUCSL >215.5 are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE (unemployment) coupled with rising labor demand (PAYEMS) strengthens labor market confidence, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE and PAYEMS does not significantly predict 20-day returns (p >0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 5.0% indicates strengthening labor market conditions, reducing uncertainty and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in periods with UNRATE <5.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly supply growth (INDPRO) reflects robust production capacity, reducing supply-side bottlenecks and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods with rising INDPRO are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing demand (HOUST) above 1000 units signals a housing boom, reducing interest rate sensitivity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in periods with HOUST >1000 are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).
